definitions.explanation: A bathroom made from a factory-built unit of molded floor, walls and tub. In apartment listings it usually means the compact kind with the toilet, sink and tub in one room.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ユニットバスだ。
examples.english: This apartment has a unit bath.

examples.japanese: ユニットバスな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a unit bath, so it's easy to clean.

examples.japanese: ユニットバス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{浴槽|よくそう}→浴槽：04985_yokusou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: In a unit bath the toilet and tub are together, so I'm looking for an apartment with a separate bath and toilet.

notes:
USAGE:
Strictly any factory-built bathroom, but in rental listings it usually means the three-in-one type ({三点|さんてん}⟦ユニット→ユニット：11597_yunitto⟧) common in small one-room apartments. Listings that keep them apart say ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧・⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧, a selling point many Japanese renters look for.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧: bath, bathroom
- ⟦{浴室|よくしつ}→浴室：05301_yokushitsu⟧: bathroom (more formal)
